description: Look up one thing in a Dataville data source by keywords and get back the single best-matching record (full text in `body`, structured fields in `metadata`). Use describe_dataville_source to see what keywords a source expects. To get many records, filter, or page through results, use query_dataville instead.

keywords.description: Search keywords or identifier, e.g. a title, ticker, or package name

params.description: Extra query-string parameters passed through to the API as-is. Most callers need none.

summary.description: If true, truncate `body` to its first 100 characters to save tokens

name: search_dataville
title: Search a Dataville data source
